annotations.text: CANVAS BEHIND THE APP (2026-09-05): these 22 artboards predate ADRs 0036-0039 (illustrations, one-hook empty states, retired quotes, tab-bar pill, ActionDock, Kept explainer). Annotations above are corrected; the drawings are not. Regeneration is queued as its own design session; see design/decisions/modules/today.md Open.

ZERO (true zero, nothing ever logged): expenses.length === 0. Chips read words, not $0.00 (ADR 0030). The art-hook-CTA block centers between the chips and the ActionDock; the quick log lives in the dock (ADR 0038), the quote is retired (ADR 0037).
Reach: Developer > Persona: new user > I'll explore on my own.

After the Door 1 first log: the InfoRibbon receipt sits under the logged-today list it comments on (ADR 0033, amended by 0038: the input is docked below everything now), then the dashed watch-nudge (needs a merchant). Both one-shot.

QUIET: history exists, nothing today. Spent chip is an honest $0.00; the quiet-day line is the persistent InfoRibbon (no X) inside the list section. Quick log in the dock (ADR 0038).
Reach: Persona: returning user, delete today's rows.

LIVE: rows for today, View all to Money > Spent. Tap a row to edit. Quick log in the dock below (ADR 0038).
Reach: Persona: returning user (or log a few).

ExpenseSheet mode=log over Spent. Save disabled until an amount (ADR 0028); one-word Save on every form sheet. Door 1 adds one coach line above the amount. Drag from the handle or the title row.
Reach: tap the quick-log field or the plus.

ExpenseSheet mode=edit: header reads Save; delete is the header icon action (trash, coral, 44pt, 12pt left of Save), instant with Undo from the toast; merchant and category chips share the pill radius. Drag from the title row dismisses.
Reach: tap a row in Today's log.

ZERO: no leak, no habit, no logs. No hero band at all; the art-hook block carries the three-step explainer (ADR 0039) and its CTA switches the pager to Spent. "Break your first habit" sits in the dock (ADR 0038), captionless at zero habits.
Reach: Persona: new user.

QUIET: logs exist, no leak yet. detectionProgress = progressTowardDetection(expenses), threshold 4 (index.tsx:793). FL-1 coach slot after the first log.
Reach: log 1 to 3 expenses at one merchant.

After Break a habit from onboarding: door3 ribbon over the pane, hero at $0.00 with the zero caption, first-run line on the card.
Reach: Persona: new user > carousel > Break a habit.

discoveredHabits.length > 0, no goal yet: "No skips yet" chip, hero $0.00, LeakCard observed (4 buys, keep logging) vs reliable (monthly rate). DT-1 coach slot on the first card.
Reach: 4 logs at one merchant.

Daily habit, unanswered today: pending dot on the chip (checkInPending), pane opens straight on the kept band, week strip with today's sage ring, question + two answers. Break affordance in the dock (ADR 0038).

Leaks found + Breaking now. Free tier at its limit: the dock affordance shows the free-plan caption and routes to /paywall?placement=habit_gate_today, not the gated sheet (open question, today.md).
Reach: Persona: returning user + a second detected leak.

Answered skipped: sage check dot, summary line, +$ kept headline, sage coach slot (sk0 on the first ever skip), Change answer. The one motion in the app (280ms pulse) fires here.
Reach: tap Skipped it.

Answered bought: cloud dot, neutral minus badge, "Logged." + kept stays yours, snow coach slot, Change answer + Spent less than usual? (opens the partial slip sheet).
Reach: tap Bought it.

A chapter crossing (10/30/50/66 skips): lavender coach slot with the "n total skips · Chapter" pill (CheckInCard.tsx:177-180).
Not reachable from personas; canvas only.

Yesterday unanswered and backfill unused: "Missed yesterday? Answer for it:" pair under a hairline (CheckInCard.tsx:406-423). One use per goal.
Not reachable from personas; canvas only.

Event cadence: weekly pill, no strip, period chip, single "I skipped one" button; the confirmation shows only on the day of the tap.
Reach: Break a habit with cadence Weekly.

isLoading: hero mounts early with $0.00, then the one-word loading line. The dock renders in this branch too (ADR 0038). Usually sub-second.
Reach: seen for a moment on cold launch; canvas only otherwise.
PickOneSheet from Break it on a LeakCard: name, evidence, one skip keeps (median prefill), cadence note, Start breaking it / Not this one.

Free tier already breaking one habit: Break it on a LeakCard opens a different sheet, not a disabled one (PickOneSheet.tsx:151-181). See Premium / Maybe later.
Reach: Persona: returning user > log 4 at one merchant > Break it.
BreakHabitSheet (Door 3 and the dock's break trigger when under the limit): preset chips or Something else, amount, cadence, yearly line, bought today.
PartialSlipSheet from "Spent less than usual?": header Save disabled until an amount; difference below the skip value counts as kept.
